name: PFC "Zekeowski"
summary: A PFC from Newark, New Jersey, photographed in a white T-shirt and blue jeans at the established camp (VN-0027). Larry gave the name phonetically twice — first "Zoo-Cow-Ski," then corrected to "Zee-Cow-Ski."
researchNotes: The phonetics point to a Polish surname. Candidates for roster and directory searches: Zykowski, Zikowski, Cikowski, Zichowski, Zekowski, Zukowski (the earlier 'Zoo-' rendering). Newark NJ had a large Polish community — a hometown that specific makes city directories and news archives viable once a spelling candidate hits.
